name: First Discovery
title: First Discovery
description: Catch your first ocean friend and open your Marinepedia.
learnWhy: Every species has a job in the ocean — spotting them is the first step to protecting them.
realWorldHook: Next time you visit an aquarium, look for name cards under each tank.

name: Meet the Reef
title: Meet the Reef
description: Discover a clownfish living near the coral city.
learnWhy: Clownfish and sea anemones help each other — a real underwater partnership!
realWorldHook: Ask a grown-up what a symbiotic relationship means.

name: Ghost Net Rescue
title: Ghost Net Rescue
description: Free animals trapped in abandoned fishing nets (press F near a net).
learnWhy: Ghost nets keep fishing forever after they're lost — freeing animals saves lives.
realWorldHook: Never leave fishing line or nets on a beach or boat.

name: Plastic Patrol
title: Plastic Patrol
description: Collect litter floating near the reef (press F near trash).
learnWhy: Plastic can float for hundreds of years and animals may think it is food.
realWorldHook: Bring a bag on your next beach or park walk and pick up five pieces of trash.

name: Deep Glow
title: Deep Glow
description: Dive deeper and discover a creature of the mid-depths.
learnWhy: Deeper water is darker and colder — life there uses light and clever senses.
realWorldHook: Most of Earth is ocean, and most of the ocean is deep and unexplored.

name: Reef Catalog
title: Reef Catalog
description: Discover 6 different species for your Marinepedia.
learnWhy: Rangers keep records so scientists and kids can track what lives where.
realWorldHook: Start a nature notebook: draw one animal and write one fact.
